notes: Primary manufacturer pages (www1.kramerav.com/Product/VP-773A and the official PDF spec sheet/manual at k.kramerav.com) returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch, so specs were extracted from a full-text mirror of the same official user manual (P/N 2900-300491 Rev 5, via usermanual.wiki) and cross-verified against the retailer ConferenceRoomAV.com spec table and Kramer search-result snippets; all sources agreed. No HDMI/Ethernet bandwidth version is stated in any source, so grade is omitted on HDMI and RJ-45 ports per instructions. HDMI 1-4 also carry embedded audio and two of them (HDMI/DP) have dedicated 3.5mm "audio takeover" jacks plus two PC (VGA) inputs each pair with a 3.5mm unbalanced audio jack; these mini-jack audio-takeover inputs are included individually as labeled in the manual. Mic jacks are Kramer-labeled "6mm" (i.e. 6.35mm/quarter-inch) TS mono jacks with switchable 48V phantom power, not XLR. Power inlet is a standard IEC AC connector with integrated fuse per the manual; exact IEC sub-type (C13/C14) not explicitly stated but is standard IEC C14 for this class of device. S/PDIF output connector type (RCA vs Toslink) is stated as RCA-style coax in the manual text but could not be double-confirmed with full certainty against the blocked primary PDF. Product is now discontinued by Kramer; suggested replacement per one retailer is the Kramer TP-580R.
